wordings.basis.OWN_FORM: This person gave their number to 50pick on a 50pick form and agreed there to receive 50pick offers and news by SMS.
wordings.basis.OWN_EVENT: This person gave their number to 50pick staff at a 50pick event or shop and agreed there to receive 50pick offers and news by SMS.
wordings.basis.AGENT_ROSTER: This person gave their number to a registered 50pick agent for 50pick and agreed to receive 50pick offers and news by SMS.
wordings.basis.THIRD_PARTY: This number came from a bought or third-party list; the person never agreed to hear from 50pick.
wordings.basis.LICENCE_OUTREACH: 50pick may send this person offers and news by SMS as outreach under its Gaming Board of Tanzania licence. The person has not agreed to receive them; every message carries a stop link, and a stop is kept for good.
wordings.adult.consent: They told us they are 18 or older.
wordings.adult.list: I confirm that every number on this list belongs to a person aged 18 or older, and I have recorded where the numbers came from.
wordings.adult.test: I confirm that the person who uses this number is 18 or older.
wordings.notice.thirdParty: These numbers will be stored without consent. They receive marketing SMS only after you put them on a list and record the licence outreach basis for it, with its 18+ confirmation.
